purpose: Non-admission discovery and source-specific bounded access preflight for public England Environment Agency and USACE flood-defence inventories, with no CAT-model approval or external data redistribution.

entries.name: Environment Agency AIMS spatial flood defences (standardised attributes)
entries.spatial_scope: England; Environment Agency-owned, managed or inspected flood-defence features; not all flood barriers or protected areas
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously updated service; data.gov.uk catalogue updated 2026-09-18; per-asset effective/inspection dates require separate validation
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer layer 0; polyline assets with standard of protection, level, condition and maintenance metadata; British National Grid EPSG:27700; one-feature no-geometry canary
entries.note: Official catalogue declares Open Government Licence for this product; full legal, attribution and source snapshot review remains open. Original provider service https://environment.data.gov.uk/arcgis/rest/services/EA/SpatialFloodDefencesIncStandardisedAttributes/FeatureServer/0 exposes query JSON. On 2026-11-14 an intermediary fetched precisely one no-geometry OBJECTID value (HTTP content shaped as FeatureServer JSON, EPSG:27700) using a bounded GET; this is not a trusted direct runner receipt or original archive SHA. Asset presence and nominal protection standard do not establish actual defended footprint, defence reliability, breach/overtopping probability, modelled flood depth reduction or insurer exposure. No original response bytes committed or model admitted.

entries.name: Environment Agency linked asset-management records and maintenance activities API
entries.spatial_scope: England; Environment Agency asset inventory, with maintenance records for a subset of assets
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously maintained operational register; historical/future maintenance events vary by asset
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Documented Linked Data REST API with asset and maintenance activity/task/plan JSON endpoints, selectable _limit; relationships require asset-level keys and version-aware joins
entries.note: Official developer documentation describes GET endpoints, query limit and a response meta.license identifying UK OGL 3.0. This is not identical to the AIMS spatial feature layer and its join keys, ownership, availability and source-rights scope require separate verification. Documentation was inspected, but no trusted original value read or asset-to-feature link was proven. A maintenance activity record is not a verified breach history, insurance loss or structural performance estimate. Do not ingest complete asset data or infer protection quality.

entries.name: USACE National Levee Database public floodwall GIS layer
entries.provider: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, National Levee Database
entries.spatial_scope: United States including available territories; coverage and submitted-record completeness vary
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously maintained database with irregular source updates; check per-record last-updated date
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Public ArcGIS NLD/Public FeatureServer layer 12 (Floodwalls), polyline geometry, NAD83 EPSG:4269; height/depth/width and system fields; one-feature no-geometry canary
entries.note: USACE explicitly states that public NLD data may be downloaded/shared/used, but public GIS records and non-public detailed NLD records differ; independently review each API service's conditions and source provenance before publication or commercial modelling. Original https://geospatial.sec.usace.army.mil/dls/rest/services/NLD/Public/FeatureServer/12 responds with public floodwalls schema (OBJECTID, FLOODWALL_ID, WALL_HEIGHT_FEET, SYSTEM_ID). On 2026-11-14 intermediary one-record no-geometry JSON was returned, EPSG:4269. No trusted original runner receipt or source-file hash. Do not assume height is certified protection, complete national coverage, hydraulic connectivity, or actual failure probability. No geometry, TIV or raw payload admitted.
